name: robustness-cpu-limit
note: Eight groups: U/K with default affinity versus all CRIU processes sharing 2, 4 or 8 logical CPUs on distinct physical cores per host. Redis and YCSB CPU resources are unchanged; all groups use NUMA 0 and RDMA 25 Gbps. Dedicated K export/dispatch workers inherit CRIU affinity. Application-context fault callbacks, NIC interrupts and shared kernel services are not capped. U/K retain their normal mode-specific PS budgets and worker counts; compare the CPU effect within each mode.
